newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - July 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - July 4.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - Commentary calls Hong Kong and Shanghai "two pearls" amongst the Asian stock markets.
- Trading of new shares right after their listing has become less active since the start of June, indicating the stock markets have cooled down in response to official crackdown measures.
- BUSINESS NEWS - By the end of 1996, assets of foreign financial institutions in China accounted for 3.13 percent of the assets of all financial institutions in China.
- Commentary urges establishment of more industrial conglomerates to enhance competitiveness of the state sector.
